_comment: Neem Foundation. Thresholds below are EXTRACTED FROM THEIR SIGNED Procurement Policy (p6) and cross-checked against NEEM_Finance_Processes.pptx (2024). Where the two disagree, BOTH are recorded and the conflict is in _open_questions — see NEEM_DOCUMENT_FINDINGS.md. Apply: DOCEX_ORG=neem DOCEX_DB=./neem.db python3 org_config.py apply profiles/neem.json

workflow._source: Neem Procurement Policy p6, 'FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION' threshold table.

_thresholds_as_written.200,001 - 2,000,000: AED. Min 3 quotes. Preapproved supplier or online advert.
_thresholds_as_written.2,000,001 - 7,000,000: AED on procurement committee recommendation. Min 3 quotes. Competitive tender.
_thresholds_as_written.above 7,000,000: ED AND AED on committee recommendation. Min 5 quotes. Competitive tender.
_thresholds_as_written.sole source above 1,000,000: ED and AED, on programme manager / executive board recommendation.

workflow._documents_source: Finance Processes deck slides 8-9 and the workflow document: 'the correct pack depends on whether it concerns goods, services, an activity, an advance, a reimbursement or a final balance payment.'

_modules_note: Top-level product areas this client bought. The nav shows only these. Finance-workflow-only clients don't need the screening or knowledge modules.
_confirm_before_go_live: THRESHOLD CONFLICT — the signed Procurement Policy (p6) says three quotes are required from N200,001. The Finance Processes deck (slide 4) says a direct memo suffices up to N499,999 and RFQ starts at N500,000. These disagree across N200,001-N499,999. Ask which governs; the policy is signed, the deck is what staff are trained on.

GTBANK GAPS — payments are batched into a WEEKLY schedule and uploaded to GAPS; the AED gives final release approval inside GAPS. Confirm whether the statement shows one debit per payee or one per batch. This decides individual vs bulk in the payment ledger.

BANK STATEMENT FORMAT — still needed. Their own reconciliation is BALANCE-based (bank balance vs cashbook balance, plus unpresented, less uncredited). DOCex matches line-by-line. Both are wanted; ours finds what theirs cannot.
PAYE / PENSION RATES — still not in any document supplied. Payroll stays OFF.

BANK ACCOUNT REGISTER — build it on day one from Neem Account Details.docx (about 20 accounts across GTBank, Zenith and Lotus, plus Neem Institute Ltd as a separate entity). Until an account is registered, its statement cannot be reconciled — which is deliberate.
WHT SCHEDULE — their cashbook shows 5% and 10%. Get the actual schedule from their auditor before switching withholding on; DOCex ships no rates and will withhold nothing until it is entered.
_departments_note: From 'Neem Finance and Procurement Workflow' and the Finance Processes deck. The real chain is: requesting staff -> line manager (signs memo) -> Finance/Audit (checks the pack) -> Admin (forwards) -> AED (reviews, approves) -> Head of Finance (uploads the weekly schedule to GTBank GAPS) -> AED (final approval IN GAPS releases the funds). Admin is a real routing step, not a formality, which is why it is its own department.

_account_codes._source: Observed in Neem F_CARE CASHBOOK_BANK REC Sep'23-Feb'24. Real codes in use.

_project_codes._source: Neem Account Details.docx. EACH project has its OWN bank account — see NEEM_DOCUMENT_FINDINGS.md, this is architecturally significant. Account numbers deliberately NOT recorded here.

_policy_rules_confirmed: ADVANCE RETIREMENT: 7 days or 5 working days from receipt of payment. Escalation is explicit — failure blocks further payment to that individual; a collective default blocks the whole project's next activity; persisting to month end means recovery from salary. (Finance Processes deck, slide 10.)
DSA RETIREMENT: same 5 working days / 7 days after the trip, with a signed Unreceipted Expenses Form. A Travel Approval Form must be submitted BEFORE the trip.
MEMO DEADLINE: Mondays and Tuesdays before 2pm. Payments run on a weekly cycle.
PETTY CASH: monthly ledger, must be retired before the next disbursement.
PAYMENT TERMS: 5 working days upon receipt of a valid invoice (PO template).
PROCUREMENT COMMITTEE: reviews all procurement above N2,000,000, approves contract variations above N2,000,000, and approves the vendor list.
_bank_accounts_note: Register these with POST /treasury/accounts on first setup — account NUMBERS are deliberately not stored in this repo. Codes and project names come from Neem Account Details.docx. Reconciliation refuses to run without knowing which account a statement belongs to, because a payment of the same amount exists in several of them.

_reference_format._source: Observed on every cashbook line: NF/HQ/B24/CARE/SEP23/PV/01
_reference_format._note: Generating THEIR reference rather than REQ-0001 means DOCex output files straight into their existing system with no translation. Not yet implemented — see DOCEX_IMPROVEMENT_AUDIT.md item 4.

advance_policy._source: NEEM_Finance_Processes.pptx slide 10, verbatim: 'must be retired within 7 days or 5 working days from the date of receipt of payment. Failure ... no payment will be made to that individual ... collective default ... no payment for the implementation of that project ... persist till the end of the month ... recovered from the salary(ies).'
advance_policy._dsa_note: DSA runs the same clock but from the END of the trip — 'retired within 5 working days or 7 days after the event/trip has been concluded'. A travel approval form must exist BEFORE the trip.
advance_policy._confirm: collective_default_count is set to 2 as a working assumption. Their policy says 'a collective default' without defining how many. Ask.
